description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 2620002697270 INNER TUBE,PNEUMATI: Line 0001 Qty 951 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0066 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract).
